data.name: NotFoundDetail
data.value: There is no transfer with the ID {0}: it finished and was forgotten, it was abandoned, or it belongs to another vault.

data.name: LimitReachedDetail
data.value: There are already 3 transfers in progress (exports, imports or copies to another database). Wait for one to finish, or cancel one in the status bar.

data.name: CredentialsMissingTitle
data.value: Connection without a user or password.

data.name: UserNameMissingDetail
data.value: This connection has no saved user. Fill it in under Edit connection and export again.

data.name: PasswordMissingDetail
data.value: This connection has no saved password. Fill it in under Edit connection and export again.

data.name: DatabaseNameInvalidDetail
data.value: The database name must have 1 to 128 characters, with no control characters.

data.name: OptionsInvalidTitle
data.value: Error sending data to the API.

data.name: InformixRowsDetail
data.value: Informix does not accept several rows in one INSERT.

data.name: MarkersMismatchTitle
data.value: The markers do not match the values.

data.name: NotReadDetail
data.value: Exporting runs the statement again, and only a read can be exported: {0}. Nothing was sent to the database.

data.name: SshSecretMissingDetail
data.value: The SSH tunnel password (or key passphrase) is not saved in this connection. Enter it when Prism asks and try again: without "Save credentials", it stays only in memory until the connection is disconnected or Prism is locked.

data.name: ProxyPasswordMissingDetail
data.value: The proxy password is not saved in this connection. Enter it when Prism asks and try again: without "Save credentials", it stays only in memory until the connection is disconnected or Prism is locked.
